records.source: Hi... Everything okay?
records.translation: Kumusta... Ayos lang ba ang lahat?

records.source: Wow, tastes just like golden walnuts! This is great!
records.translation: Wow, lasang-lasang Ginintuang Walnut! Napakasarap nito!

records.source: This is a precious egg... A baby! I'm glad you brought it to me, I'll keep it safe.
records.translation: Napakahalagang itlog nito... Isang sanggol! Natutuwa akong dinala mo ito sa akin. Pananatilihin ko itong ligtas.

records.source: I've learned a lot from my parrot family...#$b#But I'm sure there's a lot more out there I don't know.$s
records.translation: Marami akong natutuhan mula sa pamilya kong mga loro...#$b#Pero tiyak kong marami pa akong hindi alam sa labas.$s

records.source: When Sun is angry, it feels good in the jungle.#$e#Sun can't find us beneath the leaves. We trick him! Haha...$h
records.translation: Kapag galit ang Araw, masarap sa gubat-tropikal.#$e#Hindi kami mahahanap ng Araw sa ilalim ng mga dahon. Nalilinlang namin siya! Haha...$h

records.source: ...Sorry... I'm shy today.$3
records.translation: ...Paumanhin... Nahihiya ako ngayon.$3

records.source: Be careful in the volcano... the spirits don't like outsiders.
records.translation: Mag-ingat ka sa bulkan... ayaw ng mga espiritu sa mga tagalabas.

records.source: Have you met the others like you?#$b#I don't talk to them much. I feel safer with my own kind...$3
records.translation: Nakilala mo na ba ang iba pang tulad mo?#$b#Hindi ko sila gaanong kinakausap. Mas ligtas ako kasama ang mga kauri ko...$3

records.source: One time... I was at the top of the volcano at night, and I saw lights far, far away.#$b#I wonder if there are other bird families out there?$3
records.translation: Minsan... nasa tuktok ako ng bulkan sa gabi at may nakita akong mga ilaw sa napakalayo.#$b#May iba pa kayang pamilya ng mga ibon doon?$3

records.source: I wonder if I could see your home from the top of the volcano?
records.translation: Makikita ko kaya ang tahanan mo mula sa tuktok ng bulkan?

records.source: ...I'm sad today.$s#$e#You go on... have fun. Let me be sad.$s
records.translation: ...Malungkot ako ngayon.$s#$e#Sige lang... magsaya ka. Hayaan mo akong malungkot.$s

records.source: When it rains, strange birds visit.#$b#I try to speak to them... but they fly away.$s#$b#I guess they don't want to be friends...$s
records.translation: Kapag umuulan, bumibisita ang mga kakaibang ibon.#$b#Sinusubukan kong kausapin sila... pero lumilipad sila palayo.$s#$b#Marahil ayaw nilang makipagkaibigan...$s

records.source: Oh, a stranger! My name's Vincent.#$b#Momma says not to talk to strangers... But you seem okay.
records.translation: Ah, isang estranghero! Vincent ang pangalan ko.#$b#Sabi ni Mama, huwag kumausap ng mga estranghero... Pero mukhang ayos ka naman.

records.source: Is that a birthday present? Can I open it now?#$b#Oh, wow! This is exactly what I wanted! Yayayaya!$h
records.translation: Regalo ba iyan sa kaarawan? Maaari ko na bang buksan?#$b#Ah, wow! Ito mismo ang gusto ko! Yayayaya!$h

records.source: A birthday present? Oh... this isn't very fun.$s
records.translation: Regalo sa kaarawan? Ah... hindi ito gaanong masaya.$s

records.source: Wow! It's so sweet! Mmmmm....
records.translation: Wow! Napakatamis! Mmmmm...

records.source: *Squish* *squish* ... Ewww! Can I have it? Can I have it? Yaaay!$h
records.translation: *pisil* *pisil*... Ewww! Maaari bang sa akin na? Maaari ba? Yehey!$h

records.source: Mom! I wanna go outside and play!%noturn
records.translation: Ma! Gusto kong lumabas at maglaro!%noturn

records.source: %Vincent is covered in moss.
records.translation: %Natatakpan ng lumot si Vincent.

records.source: *sniff*... what is this? It smells awful... Mommmm!!!$s
records.translation: *singhot*... ano ito? Napakasama ng amoy... Mamaaaa!!!$s

records.source: That was fun! I wanna be a boat captain some day!
records.translation: Masaya iyon! Gusto kong maging kapitan ng bangka balang araw!

records.source: I wanna come back soon!
records.translation: Gusto kong bumalik agad!

records.source: I wanna see a shark!$h
records.translation: Gusto kong makakita ng pating!$h

records.source: Don't take my Sammy away!$s
records.translation: Huwag mong ilayo ang Sammy ko!$s

records.source: If you look close, you can see little bugs jumping out of the sand.$h
records.translation: Kung titingnan mong mabuti, makikita mo ang maliliit na kulisap na tumatalon mula sa buhangin.$h

records.source: Oooh! Nice find!#$b#Mom wouldn't let me keep him, though...$s
records.translation: Oooh! Ang ganda ng nahanap mo!#$b#Pero hindi ako papayagan ni Mama na alagaan siya...$s

records.source: I wanna be just like my big brother when I grow up!$h#$e#Okay! Bye!
records.translation: Gusto kong maging katulad ng kuya ko paglaki ko!$h#$e#Sige! Paalam!

records.source: $d kent#I'm glad Dad's back... but he's different than I remember...$s|Dad's not around much... I miss playing with him.$s
records.translation: $d kent#Masaya akong nakabalik na si Papa... pero iba na siya sa naaalala ko...$s|Madalas wala si Papa... Nami-miss kong makipaglaro sa kaniya.$s

records.source: *sigh*... Mom won't let me have any more gummies today.$s
records.translation: *buntong-hininga*... Ayaw akong payagan ni Mama na kumain pa ng mga gummy candy ngayon.$s

records.source: Can you keep a secret, mister?^Can you keep a secret, miss?$u#$b#I wanna marry Miss Penny when I grow up.#$e#Just don't tell her, okay?$u
records.translation: Marunong ka bang magtago ng lihim, kuya?^Marunong ka bang magtago ng lihim, ate?$u#$b#Gusto kong pakasalan si Binibining Penny paglaki ko.#$e#Huwag mo lang sabihin sa kaniya, sige?$u

records.source: I wanna look for bugs, but Mom gets mad when I'm all dirty.$u#$b#It's a tough choice.
records.translation: Gusto kong maghanap ng mga kulisap, pero nagagalit si Mama kapag maruming-marumi ako.$u#$b#Mahirap pumili.

records.source: I'm hungry... where's Mom?$s
records.translation: Gutom na ako... nasaan si Mama?$s

records.source: You're not as boring as most grown-ups!
records.translation: Hindi ka kasimbagot ng karamihan sa matatanda!

records.source: #$c .3#Ew, it's boiled beet night again...$s#$e#Oh no... Mom's making lentil soup tonight.$s
records.translation: #$c .3#Ew, pinakuluang beet na naman ang hapunan...$s#$e#Naku... Gumagawa si Mama ng sopas na lentil ngayong gabi.$s

records.source: Dad's coming back soon!#$b#I hope he brings me some toys.$u
records.translation: Malapit nang bumalik si Papa!#$b#Sana may dala siyang mga laruan.$u

records.source: Miss Penny makes me read a new book every week.$s#$b#At least she lets me pick them, sometimes!
records.translation: Pinababasa ako ni Binibining Penny ng bagong aklat linggo-linggo.$s#$b#Mabuti na lang at minsan ay pinapapili niya ako!

records.source: $d kent#Dad seems weird since he came back. I wonder what happened to him?$s#$b#He doesn't play with me anymore.$s|I wonder if Dad will ever come home...$s
records.translation: $d kent#Mukhang kakaiba si Papa mula nang bumalik. Ano kaya ang nangyari sa kaniya?$s#$b#Hindi na niya ako kalaro.$s|Uuwi pa kaya si Papa...$s

records.source: Hi there, mister!^Hi there, miss.
records.translation: Kumusta, kuya!^Kumusta, ate!

records.source: Hi Uncle @!^Hi Auntie @!#$e#Don't tell Mom... but you're my favorite grown-up.$h
records.translation: Kumusta, Tito @!^Kumusta, Tita @!#$e#Huwag mong sabihin kay Mama... pero ikaw ang paborito kong nakatatanda.$h

records.source: You found the {0}. Better return it to {1}.
records.translation: Nahanap mo ang {0}. Mas mabuting ibalik ito kay {1}.

records.source: Return to {0}.
records.translation: Bumalik kay {0}.
